    • getReferenceKind

      public int getReferenceKind()
      Returns the kind of reference to which this constant is pointing.
      Returns:
      One of REF_GET_FIELD, REF_GET_STATIC, REF_PUT_FIELD, REF_PUT_STATIC, REF_INVOKE_VIRTUAL, REF_INVOKE_STATIC, REF_INVOKE_SPECIAL, REF_NEW_INVOKE_SPECIAL, or REF_INVOKE_INTERFACE.
